 Janakpur Bolts Lose Third Wicket Against Biratnagar Kings
 Ratopati
 November 03, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Janakpur Bolts have lost their third wicket in the ongoing match against Biratnagar Kings at TU Cricket Ground on Tuesday under the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 Chasing a target of 174 runs set by Biratnagar, Janakpur lost their third wicket for 30 runs in 4.4 overs.
 Janakpur's Anil Sah was out without opening his account off 2 balls. He was caught out by Imran Sheikh off Andre Russell.
 Russell had previously dismissed Moeen Ali for 10 runs. Janakpur's Tritaraj Das was out for 6 runs.
